rv.q: What lingers, in the end, is the uncomfortable recognition that the characters’ hubris is not entirely alien.
In an era when new plays often struggle to find both intellectual rigor and theatrical propulsion, Spare Parts manages to deliver both.

cn.t: Critics praise this biotech thriller for its expert scientific authenticity and timely exploration of mortality and power, with the playwright's medical background lending distinctive credibility to the production.

vr.q: Spare Parts is a thought-provoking, sharply acted, smartly directed new play that is asking exactly the right questions for this moment in time.
